summary: Strabo on the Achaean wall at Troy: Homer built it and then "abolished" it, as Aristotle says. This is the saying that Strabo (2.3.6) says Posidonius applied to Plato's Atlantis: the inventor made it disappear. The Atlantis link is in 2.3.6, not here.

tree.title: Strabo, Geography 13.1.36: the Achaean wall "fabricated and then abolished by the poet, as Aristotle says"
tree.summary: Strabo argues the Greek naval station at Troy would have been exposed for a long time, and says the wall was either built only recently or never built, "fabricated and then abolished by the poet, as Aristotle says". The Atlantis connection comes from 2.3.6.
